name: Katomama no Bou Shirushi (Zetsurin Orc Hen)
original_name: カトママの棒験(絶倫オーク編)
source:
Cattl*ya has been bested and brought home by an Orc army. There a milky feast unfurls as the violently demanding orcs persecute and sexually liberate her spirit.
"So good! I'll be your mommy!"

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE060536.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
卡特蕾婭被獸人大軍擊敗，帶回了營地。兇暴而慾求不滿的獸人折磨著她，也在性慾中解放了她的心靈，一場乳汁盛宴就此展開。
「好舒服！我來當你們的媽媽！」
